idea-plugin.name: Context Packer
idea-plugin.description: Find relevant project source for coding tasks using Jev, local Laya, or local keyword ranking. Inspect and adjust the selected files, copy a bounded source prompt, or request an answer from a configured cloud model. Available from a tool window and as an MCP tool for agents. Laya requires a local model server; keyword ranking needs no model or API key.
